+++ b/src/click/comma_extra_arguments.py
@@ -0,0 +1,37 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from gettext import ngettext
+
+from .core import Command
+from .core import Context
+from .core import iter_params_for_processing
+from .exceptions import NoArgsIsHelpError
+
+
+class CommaExtraArguments(Command):
+    """A :class:`Command` that separates unexpected extra arguments with a
+    comma and space in its usage error message.
+    """
+
+    def parse_args(self, ctx: Context, args: list[str]) -> list[str]:
+        if not args and self.no_args_is_help and not ctx.resilient_parsing:
+            raise NoArgsIsHelpError(ctx)
+
+        parser = self.make_parser(ctx)
+        opts, args, param_order = parser.parse_args(args=args)
+
+        for param in iter_params_for_processing(param_order, self.get_params(ctx)):
+            value, args = param.handle_parse_result(ctx, opts, args)
+
+        if args and not ctx.allow_extra_args and not ctx.resilient_parsing:
+            ctx.fail(
+                ngettext(
+                    "Got unexpected extra argument ({args})",
+                    "Got unexpected extra arguments ({args})",
+                    len(args),
+                ).format(args=", ".join(map(str, args)))
+            )
+
+        ctx.args = args
+        ctx._opt_prefixes.update(parser._opt_prefixes)
+        return args
diff --git a/tests/test_comma_extra_arguments.py b/tests/test_comma_extra_arguments.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..ac7d1dc
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_comma_extra_arguments.py
@@ -0,0 +1,28 @@
+import click
+from click.comma_extra_arguments import CommaExtraArguments
+
+
+def _cmd():
+    @click.command(cls=CommaExtraArguments)
+    @click.argument("name")
+    def cli(name):
+        click.echo(name)
+
+    return cli
+
+
+def test_extra_arguments_joined_with_comma(runner):
+    result = runner.invoke(_cmd(), ["a", "b", "c"])
+    assert result.exit_code == 2
+    assert "Got unexpected extra arguments (b, c)" in result.output
+
+
+def test_single_extra_argument(runner):
+    result = runner.invoke(_cmd(), ["a", "b"])
+    assert "Got unexpected extra argument (b)" in result.output
+
+
+def test_normal_invocation(runner):
+    result = runner.invoke(_cmd(), ["a"])
+    assert result.exit_code == 0
+    assert result.output == "a\n"
